item.title: Show HN: Convert Documents to Markdown
item.summary: Pandoc showed how useful a universal document converter can be. zenfmt is a small attempt to explore that idea with an engine written in Zig. We built to make document conversion effortless, it converts 19 document formats into Markdown in milliseconds.
